newsitem.title: UK: Gerrard to bid for Cater Allen - report.
newsitem.headline: Gerrard to bid for Cater Allen - report.

text.p: British financial services provider and stockbroker Gerrard & National will emerge as the bidder for British financial services group Cater Allen, Sunday Business newspaper said on Sunday.
Cater Allen said on Thursday it was in talks which could possibly lead to a recommended offer.
A bid is expected to value Cater Allen at 200 million pounds, Sunday Business said.
Gerrard & National merged with fellow former discount house King & Shaxson in October.
Cater Allen, another former discount house, bought Union Plc's equity market-making subsidiary Aitken Campbell & Co Ltd in March.
No one at Gerrard National or Cater Allen could be reached for comment.
